last.q: Gilead delivered an exceptional third quarter, with our strongest year-over-year base business growth in more than a decade, reflecting the strength, breadth and durability of our business,
last.a: said Daniel O’Day, Gilead’s Chairman and Chief Executive Officer

last.q: Gilead delivered a very strong second quarter, with 10% year-over-year revenue growth in our base business driven by our HIV portfolio, Trodelvy and Livdelzi. HIV sales grew 12%, reflecting continued strength in treatment and the rapid expansion of our PrEP business, supporting an increase in our base business revenue …
last.a: said Daniel O’Day, Gilead’s Chairman and Chief Executive Officer

last.q: Gilead teams have delivered another strong quarter with 8% year-over-year growth in our base business and 10% growth in HIV, supported by the successful launch of Yeztugo. We have raised our full year revenue guidance as a reflection of our performance,
last.a: said Daniel O’Day, Gilead’s Chairman and Chief Executive Officer

last.q: With the Arcellx acquisition, our focus turns to executing with speed and discipline as we prepare to bring anito-cel to patients,
last.a: said Cindy Perettie, Executive Vice President and Global Head of Kite

last.q: This agreement reflects our conviction in the potential of anito-cel and our intention to move with speed so we can make the most of that potential for patients with multiple myeloma,
last.a: said Daniel O’Day, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer, Gilead Sciences

last.q: Our fourth quarter and full-year results close out a very strong year for Gilead overall, including the successful U.S. launch of Yeztugo, the world’s first twice-yearly HIV prevention therapy, and continued growth for Biktarvy and Descovy,
last.a: said Daniel O’Day, Gilead’s Chairman and Chief Executive Officer
